## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Ripoll, Spain. It starts at Tourism Office (Train Station at La Pobla de Lillet), Carretera B-402.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Hidden away in the Pyrenees, Gaudí created a garden that has stood the test of time after more than a century. With tickets for Jardins Artigas, you can see his signature style throughout, including his broken mosaic style of trencadís which any fans of Park Güell will be quick to recognize.
>
> As you stroll through the gardens – admiring fountains, benches, railings and bridges – cast your eyes back to the early 1900s when Gaudí was called to La Pobla de Lillet by wealthy factory owner Eusebi Güell, and asked to create a refuge for the workers and engineers of the Catllaràs mountain coal mine.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €6.19. It was rated 4.6 out of 5 from 193 ratings and 115 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
